about: Models checked end to end: built in headless Chromium by the site's own code, then compared with PyTorch transformers on the same weights (tools/check_hf.mjs + tools/ref_hf.py). Prompt: 'The capital of France is'. Pass = same token ids, residual norms within 1e-3, attention within 1e-3, same top-1, top-10 overlap >= 9, top-10 probabilities within 5e-3.
